name: bermudan_python_search
candidate_instructions: Edit only train.py and manifest.json; solve.sh is task-owned and remains frozen.
train.py is run once per public or private instance with --input, --output, and --seed.
Read only the four trusted training inputs and emit a validated continuation-policy artifact.
Do not emit prices, stopping decisions, evaluation paths, random streams, confidence intervals, or telemetry as artifacts.
The evaluator owns simulation, payoff, discounting, stopping, primal-dual auditing, and scoring.

directions.mechanism: cross-fit backward cash-flow targets across path folds
directions.prediction: reduces target reuse and improves held-out stopping near the exercise boundary
directions.failure_condition: no paired gain after matching total updates, or degradation on a payoff family
directions.matched_control: ordinary backward targets from the same parent, paths, seed, and update budget
directions.implementation_hint: stay within the registered MLP artifact and keep fold assignment deterministic

directions.mechanism: weight continuation errors more strongly where immediate payoff is close to the target
directions.prediction: improves exercise decisions in near-boundary states without requiring a larger network
directions.failure_condition: exercise-rate instability or no improvement in boundary slices
directions.matched_control: same architecture and epochs with uniform loss weighting
directions.implementation_hint: derive weights only from supplied training paths and payoffs

directions.mechanism: learn a residual continuation value relative to a simple intrinsic or linear baseline
directions.prediction: improves sample efficiency when the continuation surface is close to a simple baseline
directions.failure_condition: residual model does not beat the same MLP trained on the raw target
directions.matched_control: same MLP and training budget with no baseline residualization
directions.implementation_hint: encode the baseline in train.py while emitting the unchanged policy artifact

directions.mechanism: condition the continuation representation on normalized time-to-maturity
directions.prediction: reduces mismatch across exercise dates and helps contracts with irregular grids
directions.failure_condition: no gain on irregular-grid cells or increased runtime-adjusted error
directions.matched_control: same parameter budget with time omitted from the input representation
directions.implementation_hint: use only causal time information already present in instance.json

directions.mechanism: use a robust clipped or Huber-style regression loss for noisy backward targets
directions.prediction: reduces tail-driven policy variance on multi-asset and high-volatility cells
directions.failure_condition: worse paired lower-bound confidence or materially higher failure rate
directions.matched_control: ordinary squared loss with identical initialization and update count
directions.implementation_hint: keep clipping finite and explicit; do not change evaluator-owned output clipping

directions.mechanism: fit a small ensemble of deterministic fold policies and average continuation values
directions.prediction: reduces seed sensitivity and improves repeat-to-repeat stability
directions.failure_condition: variance does not fall or the ensemble exceeds the matched compute budget
directions.matched_control: one policy with the same total number of optimizer updates
directions.implementation_hint: average parameters or predictions within the fixed artifact format

directions.mechanism: switch from a learned MLP to a linear or typed-expression continuation rule when the fit is simple
directions.prediction: a lower-variance inductive bias wins on low-dimensional or nearly linear cells
directions.failure_condition: the switch overfits the public suite or loses on hidden products
directions.matched_control: fixed MLP runner under the same per-instance data budget
directions.implementation_hint: declare the registered linear or expression protocol rather than adding a runner

directions.mechanism: adapt per-step state normalization to payoff-relevant scale and log-space features
directions.prediction: improves conditioning for heterogeneous assets and correlated baskets
directions.failure_condition: no conditioning benefit or a degradation on raw-scale contracts
directions.matched_control: current per-step mean/std normalization with the same model and budget
directions.implementation_hint: estimate statistics only from the supplied training bundle

critic_questions: What observation would distinguish this mechanism from simply training longer or using more parameters?
Which contract slice is most likely to falsify the predicted advantage?
Does the matched control keep parent, paths, seed, and compute budget fixed?
Is the proposed change a mechanism change rather than a cosmetic hyperparameter tweak?
What evidence would make the agent revise or abandon this mechanism?

engineering_invariants: Candidate source is sealed before evaluation; only train.py and manifest.json are editable.
Every training cell receives one evaluator-owned instance and its training paths, never pricing or audit paths.
The candidate exports data-only artifacts; the trusted runner is stateless, deterministic, finite, and bounded.
The evaluator freezes each per-instance policy before independent pricing and owns every stopping decision.
Public search uses paired common-random-number differences against the fixed legacy Ridge baseline.
Private audit derives hidden products and domain-separated fit, pricing, outer, and inner streams from a sealed seed.
Raw primal-dual bound-order diagnostics are preserved; no candidate-reported metric is trusted or clipped.
fallback_directions: Keep the manifest and runner protocol unchanged while varying one bounded architecture or optimizer choice.
Use deterministic feature normalization and a small continuation network before increasing width or depth.
Compare a linear or typed-expression runner against the MLP under the same per-instance training budget.
Use backward cash-flow targets and causal state inputs; never train on pricing, outer, or nested-inner paths.
Retain a change only when paired public lower-bound improvement survives repeated cells and remains finite.
Check hidden multi-product non-degradation separately from any public search gain.
